dedupe_keys.name: fhwa urban congestion reports quarterly congestion and reliability measures

description: The Federal Highway Administration's Quarterly Urban Congestion Report characterises the latest traffic congestion and travel time reliability trends at national and city level, comparing the most recent three months with the same months of the previous year. Since mid-2013 the reports use vehicle probe travel time data from FHWA's National Performance Management Research Data Set, and measures are weighted by traffic volumes from the Highway Performance Monitoring System. The reports cover 54 urban areas. The site also offers a monthly U.S. Interstate congestion dashboard, monthly urban reports, annual trends, documentation and definitions of the travel time reliability measures. Coverage is national across major US urban areas. Access: free PDF reports, with quarterly editions from 2021 to April-June 2026 on the page. Caveats: the measures are aggregate indicators, not link data, and a contract change delayed the 2020 reports. The reports support benchmarking of network performance, validation of congestion outputs from network flow models and resilience tracking after disruptions. They complement the HPMS and Caltrans PeMS data catalogued here.
